title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
slides: Is Ramp's data hiding an AI spending freeze?
Businesses slowed AI tool adoption in recent months
Yet Anthropic is preparing its IPO right now
Your AI vendors may raise prices or pivot soon
Audit one AI subscription this week: is it still used?
thread_text:
1. The AI spending freeze nobody sees

Ramp's transaction data shows real companies quietly cutting AI tool budgets. But the same week, Anthropic is prepping its IPO.

2. Adoption slowed, but not everywhere

Businesses pulled back on new AI seats and renewals in recent months. The slowdown isn't a collapse — it's a pause while vendors hold their breath.

3. Anthropic's IPO timing is the tell

If demand were truly dead, you don't file to go public. The IPO signals vendors expect the pause to end — or they need public money to survive it.

4. Vendors will come for your budget

When growth slows, prices go up or products pivot. Expect renewal offers with new tiers, forced upgrades, and 'limited-time' pricing before the end of the quarter.

5. Audit one subscription this week

Open your billing dashboard and pick the AI tool you've paid for longest. Check last month's usage. If it's near zero, cancel it today — before renewal hits.
